<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"List the announced cartons of an ASN"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/asns/{asnNumber}/cartons"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Not paged (`x-pagination-exempt: view`): a composite view of one ASN's
announced cartons, bounded by the ASN and returned with the ASN's
`ETag`, so a page boundary would split a single consistent snapshot.
The cartons the supplier announced (`cartons` is empty for a flat ASN)
with the status of each against the ASN's receipt: `Expected` (no
receipt yet, or not scanned yet), `Accepted` (its SSCC was scanned) or
`Missing` (the receipt is closed and it never was). Cartons are
announced on `POST /asns`; there is no endpoint to add one later.
